description: This Java class defines enumerations and related utilities for account number prefix types in the Fineract platform. It includes enum definitions, mappings, and methods for converting enum values to data transfer objects, tailored for account number formatting flexibility.

classes.name: AccountNumberFormatEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class providing enumerations and static methods for account number prefix types and associated data formatting.

classes.name: AccountNumberPrefixType
classes.description: Enumeration representing various account number prefix types, each with associated integer value and code string.

methods.name: entityAccountType
methods.description: Converts EntityAccountType or account type ID into EnumOptionData.

methods.name: accountNumberPrefixType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for given AccountNumberPrefixType or array of such types.
